note: Each checkpoint is the hash of one entry in the private, append-only, hash-chained experiment ledger. Because every entry's hash covers the previous entry's hash, a checkpoint fixes every entry up to and including it. Checkpoints prove nothing about entries before the date they were first published here. From 2026-10-26 each published version of this file is submitted to OpenTimestamps, and its proof ledger-checkpoints.json.ots anchors the newest checkpoint to a Bitcoin block.
